The test reports of a published release are generated beside this page: <version>/reports/ carries the JUnit, JaCoCo, Cucumber and PIT mutation reports of every module with a test suite. Each module is gated at mutationThreshold = 100 (zero surviving mutants) unless it appears in the mutationExemptions map with a measured score and documented reason. The same tree is attached to the GitHub release as reports-<version>.zip, so a report outlives a rebuilt site.
